# A17-S28: Deliverables

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]

Cool, I hadn't received that! I think the points are fine, and I'm working on all of them. I only have two corrections and a couple of questions, so we agree on what I promise - I want to be sure I can fulfill it just like last time :-)

Correction
1) I had understood it as if we were going to extend to 31 December and not the 01? That's at least what I've planned my calendar around with regard to a larger grant application, since then I can reach Novo Nordisk funds for art. If we write the 01 December, then I'd like to have “major” removed from the grant application, as I don't know if it can be achieved within the period. (Regardless, funding must be applied for, and I'm also open to looking at other possibilities again after the period ends).

2) (V) insert “public” before exhibition

- I think the project is best suited for exhibition in the public space - here hanging election posters is a very clear example, but could also be web exhibitions for example. So I think we should (!) do that. But I'd prefer not to promise a gallery exhibition, as it is just hard to know if a good opportunity arises within the period. Of course, we should do it if it makes sense.

Additionally:
- I don't know if we can get an AI-generated column. But I think it's an obvious offer to give the media if we get it going again in Denmark. But do we agree that it's a somewhat loose idea, and not a must-have?

- That curating the exhibition with CATCH and Datahistorisk we agree probably will not take place in 2022, but that I will start the work?

What do you think of this? :-)
